entries.original: Every GPT-5.6 Hephaestus intent line must declare the exact observable condition that ends the turn.
entries.translated: Every GPT-5.6 Hephaestus intent line must declare the exact observable condition that ends the turn.

entries.original: Ultrawork must register the goal through `create_goal`, include a binding `WHEN TO STOP`, and rank “is the user’s problem actually solved?” above ledger ceremony.
entries.translated: Ultrawork must register the goal through `create_goal`, include a binding `WHEN TO STOP`, and rank “is the user’s problem actually solved?” above ledger ceremony.

entries.original: The moment the stop goal holds, the agent must answer and stop immediately: no extra verification loop, polish pass, review cycle, or bonus refactor.
entries.translated: The moment the stop goal holds, the agent must answer and stop immediately: no extra verification loop, polish pass, review cycle, or bonus refactor.

entries.original: Every spawned subagent must receive `GOAL`, `STOP WHEN`, and `EVIDENCE`, so the parent can control completion by an observable contract instead of trusting a vague “done.”
entries.translated: Every spawned subagent must receive `GOAL`, `STOP WHEN`, and `EVIDENCE`, so the parent can control completion by an observable contract instead of trusting a vague “done.”

entries.original: [Layout Brief](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/guides/layout-brief.md) inspired declaring scroll ownership, fixed/sticky/static regions, constraints, viewport-vs-container responsiveness, and content stress before CSS is written.
entries.translated: [Layout Brief](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/guides/layout-brief.md) inspired declaring scroll ownership, fixed/sticky/static regions, constraints, viewport-vs-container responsiveness, and content stress before CSS is written.

entries.original: [scroll-body-shell](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/patterns/viewport-shell/scroll-body-shell.md) inspired the bounded app-shell contract: `auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto`, a single named scroll body, and the load-bearing `min-block-size: 0` fix.
entries.translated: [scroll-body-shell](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/patterns/viewport-shell/scroll-body-shell.md) inspired the bounded app-shell contract: `auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto`, a single named scroll body, and the load-bearing `min-block-size: 0` fix.

entries.original: [ram-grid](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/patterns/grid-repetition/ram-grid.md) inspired the overflow-safe intrinsic grid using `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(16rem, 100%), 1fr))`.
entries.translated: [ram-grid](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/patterns/grid-repetition/ram-grid.md) inspired the overflow-safe intrinsic grid using `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(16rem, 100%), 1fr))`.

entries.original: StyleGallery’s pattern catalog inspired OMO’s shared spatial vocabulary: stack, cluster, content limiter, sidebar, switcher, cover, frame, reel, imposter, overlay stack, fixed sidenav shell, list-detail, and sticky aside.
entries.translated: StyleGallery’s pattern catalog inspired OMO’s shared spatial vocabulary: stack, cluster, content limiter, sidebar, switcher, cover, frame, reel, imposter, overlay stack, fixed sidenav shell, list-detail, and sticky aside.

entries.original: [Layout Gate](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/quality/gates/layout.md) and the [Dashboard recipe](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/recipes/dashboard.md) inspired the strict boundary between spatial mechanics and visual taste, plus source-order, scroll, reflow, and decision-priority checks.
entries.translated: [Layout Gate](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/quality/gates/layout.md) and the [Dashboard recipe](https://github.com/changeroa/StyleGallery/blob/main/recipes/dashboard.md) inspired the strict boundary between spatial mechanics and visual taste, plus source-order, scroll, reflow, and decision-priority checks.
